description: This file defines an interface and a template class for hash stream processing within the WPEFramework Crypto namespace. It includes external dependencies on HMAC, Hash, and Module headers, and declares the IHashStream interface and HashStreamType template class for hash and HMAC streaming functionalities.

classes.name: IHashStream
classes.description: An interface for hash stream operations, including methods for retrieving hash type, resetting, obtaining result, getting length, and inputting data.

classes.name: HashStreamType
classes.description: A template class implementing hash and HMAC streaming functionalities, parameterized by the hash algorithm type and hash type enumeration.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the length of the hash output.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Feeds data into the hash stream.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the type of hash algorithm used.
